rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for physically lifting something upward.

example.english: I will raise my hand first.
example.jyutping: ngo5 geoi2 hei2 zek3 sau2 sin1

rows.note: Use this for making a level, amount, or standard higher.

example.english: We need to raise the quality of our service.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai4 gou1 fuk6 mou6 zat1 sou3

rows.note: Use this for bringing up children or keeping and raising animals.

example.english: My mother had to raise the three of us on her own.
example.traditional: 我媽咪一個人養大我哋三兄妹。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maa1 mi1 jat1 go3 jan4 joeng5 daai6 ngo5 dei6 saam1 hing1 mui6

rows.note: Use this specifically when raising money, especially for a cause or project, rather than raising troops.

example.english: The school will raise funds for the earthquake victims.
example.traditional: 學校會為地震災民籌款。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 wui5 wai6 dei6 zan3 zoi1 man4 cau4 fun2
